en.headline: Police arrest man after hit-and-run at Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge checkpoint
en.dek: A man in his thirties was held in Tuen Mun after a car struck a barrier at the checkpoint overnight and officers intercepted the vehicle following a chase.
body: Police arrested a man on suspicion of furious driving after a vehicle struck a barrier gate at the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge checkpoint early on Monday and then left the scene.
The force said the car hit the gate at an inspection booth in the bridge area at 1.17am. The case was classified as a damage-only traffic accident and a hit-and-run, with no injuries reported.

Officers later located the vehicle in Tuen Mun and intercepted it on Hoi Wong Road at 11.08am after a pursuit that included attempts to evade roadblocks. A man in his thirties was arrested at the scene. Police said no prohibited items were found in an initial search of the car.

zh.headline: 私家車港珠澳大橋口岸撞閘不顧而去 警方屯門截車拘捕三十多歲男子
zh.dek: 一輛私家車凌晨在港珠澳大橋口岸撞到檢查亭閘後逃走，警方早上在屯門截獲車輛，拘捕一名三十多歲男子。
body: 警方表示，一輛私家車於周一凌晨1時17分在港珠澳大橋範圍撞到檢查亭的閘後不顧而去，案件暫列沒有傷者的交通意外及不顧而去。
警方其後展開追捕，並在主要道路設置路障。至上午11時08分，人員在屯門海皇路截獲涉事車輛，現場拘捕一名三十多歲男子，涉嫌狂亂駕駛。
初步搜查車上未發現違禁物品。警方正繼續調查，並已聯絡車主協助。
